login.heading: Log in
login.reset_body: Log in with your new password.
register.heading: Create an account
register.intro: Email and a display name. Choose a strong password (12+ characters). After registration we send a verification link to your email — you'll need to confirm before you can vote.
register.display_name_hint: How you appear to others. Can be a pseudonym.
register.password_hint: At least 12 characters. Longer is better than complex.
verify_email.heading: Verify your email
verify_email.registered_body: We sent a verification link to your email. Follow the link or paste the token below.
verify_email.resent_body: If an unverified account exists for that address, a fresh link is on its way.
verify_email.token_hint_prefilled: Token pre-filled from your verification link. Submit to verify.
verify_email.token_hint: The token arrives by email. Follow the link in it, or paste the token here.
verify_email.resend_intro: Enter your account email and we'll send a fresh verification link.
forgot_password.heading: Forgot your password?
forgot_password.intro: Enter your account email and we'll send a reset link. The link is valid for one hour.
forgot_password.sent_body: If an account exists for that address, a reset link is on its way.
reset_password.heading: Choose a new password
reset_password.token_hint_prefilled: Token pre-filled from the link in your email.
reset_password.token_hint: Paste the token from the reset email, or follow the link in it.
reset_password.password_hint: At least 12 characters. Longer is better than complex.
login_link.heading: Sign in without a password
login_link.intro: We'll email you a link that signs you in once. It's valid for 15 minutes, and only works for accounts whose email is already verified.
login_link.sent_body: If a verified account exists for that address, a sign-in link is on its way.
login_link_confirm.heading: Finish signing in
login_link_confirm.missing_body: This page needs the link from your email.
login_link_confirm.error_hint: Links work once and expire after 15 minutes.
login_link_confirm.intro: Press the button to sign in on this device. The link then stops working.
